name: Nago Natsuno
source:
She has never met Duma before, but she is a friend of Harumi and Kaoki. The three of them often hang out together.  She may have moved here, but he speaks in a Kansai dialect. 

He has a good personality, but she is too sexually open-minded.  She seems to be lonely at heart, and her desire to be sexually connected may be influenced by that.

Maybe that's the reason why she wants to connect with people sexually.  And in fact, she is the originator of the “Ladies' Alliance". She is determined to beat the other two in the race.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/firedoor/hiyakeato/page03.html]official site[/url]]
